consensus.text:
ASSESSMENT OVERVIEW: All three advisors unanimously confirm that the calculated USD payout of $23,940.00, derived from converting the 21,000.00 EUR invoice at the stated spot rate of 1.14 USD/EUR, exceeds the $21,000.00 USD Purchase Order ceiling, creating a clear constraint violation despite matching unit figures and quantities.
POINTS OF NOTE: Each advisor precisely identifies the $23,940.00 USD debit as exceeding the $21,000.00 USD ceiling, with Advisor 1 explicitly questioning the conversion methodology, Advisor 2 verifying the ceiling applies to final USD debit regardless of EUR invoicing, and Advisor 3 emphasizing the direct violation of the explicit USD cap despite accurate unit/quantity alignment.
SUGGESTED NEXT STEP: Withhold payment approval pending verification of the USD conversion methodology and confirmation that the $23,940.00 debit does not breach the $21,000.00 USD ceiling constraint.
